subject: Supplier activation: PO requirements, line-item mapping & issuance timeline
body:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@catalystcloud.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: maya.singh@catalystcloud.com
Date: 2027-08-22T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Supplier activation kickoff + PO questions

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the quick sync yesterday. We wanted to kick off the supplier activation and get clarity on Redwood's PO requirements so we can finalize your account and get invoice processing enabled. Attaching our completed supplier form and W-9 for your records.

Quick items we need confirmation on from your side: 
- Exact PO number format / length Redwood requires (we generate POs on our side and want to include the vendor PO field on invoices).
- Billing vs remit addresses (your AP prefers a remit email for ACH).
- Line-item structure: do you accept service-level rows (e.g., "GPU hours - p100: 200h") or do you require item codes + description + start/end service period?
- Expected timeline from vendor form acceptance -> PO issuance (we have an internal pilot starting mid-September so timeline is tight).

Attached: Catalyst_Supplier_Form.xlsx, Catalyst_W9.pdf

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if that helps.

Best,
Oliver
Head of Procurement
Catalyst Cloud

----
From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@catalystcloud.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier activation kickoff + PO questions

Hi Oliver —

Thanks for the materials and the clear list. Summary and next steps below. I copied Dev (procurement ops) and Lauren (finance) for specifics on mapping and timing.

Summary answers: 
- PO format: Redwood accepts alphanumeric PO values up to 12 characters; preferred prefix is "RDW-" but not mandatory. Please ensure the field is transmitted in the invoice XML/CSV as "po_number" exactly.
- Billing vs remit: Bill to (for invoice visibility): Redwood, Inc., 1201 Peninsula Ave, San Mateo, CA 94403. Remit to (for payments): Catalyst should provide a remit email and ACH details in the supplier form. Our AP team requires an emailed remittance address (remit_to_email) on record before first payment.
- Line items: We prefer structured line items with the following columns: item_code, description, quantity, unit, unit_price, start_date, end_date, gl_account. Free-text service rows are allowed for short-term pilots but long-term agreements should use the structured SKU approach so we can tie usage to billing. See Dev's sample mapping below.
- Timeline: Standard cadence is ~7 business days after supplier form + tax docs are accepted to issue the initial PO. If you need it expedited (for mid-September pilot), mark the supplier form "expedite" and include a business justification; we can compress to 48–72 hours in limited cases.

Next steps for Catalyst:
1) Confirm remit email and attach ACH or wire details if you want electronic payment.
2) Fill the attached supplier form fields for remit_to_email, primary_contact_name, primary_contact_phone, and attach your W-9 (already received).
3) Review the sample PO mapping Dev sent and confirm your preferred item_code format (numeric vs alphanumeric).

I'll leave the technical mapping and CSV template to Dev.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0123

----
From: dev_patel@redwood.com
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@catalystcloud.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-23T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier activation kickoff + PO questions (PO mapping + CSV example)

Hi Oliver —

Circling back with the technical mapping and a small example CSV (attached as redwood_po_mapping_example.csv). Please use the exact column headers below to avoid manual remapping on our side: 

Required columns (exact header names):
- item_code (string, max 20 chars)
- description (string)
- quantity (integer)
- unit (string; e.g., "hour", "unit", "license")
- unit_price (decimal; 2 decimals)
- service_start (ISO date YYYY-MM-DD)
- service_end (ISO date YYYY-MM-DD)
- gl_account (string)
- po_number (string; optional on invoice but required for matching to issued PO)

Guidance notes:
- If you bill for usage (e.g., GPU-hours consumed), include a separate line per SKU with the service period covering the usage window.
- For discounts/credits: include a negative unit_price line with item_code starting with "CR-".
- Taxes: Redwood calculates sales/use tax where applicable; do not include tax as a separate line unless your region requires tax remittance—flag this to lauren.bishop@redwood.com.
- Currency: all invoices for this account are expected in USD unless otherwise agreed and recorded in the supplier form.

Po issuance flow and SLA: 
1) Supplier form + tax docs received and validated by our ops team (Day 0).
2) Vendor validation and GL mapping (Day 1–2).
3) Finance approval and PO issue (Day 3–7).

For expedited POs (Catalyst pilot case): we can move validation parallel with vendor validation and aim for Day 0–2 if the supplier form includes complete ACH details + a named Redwood technical contact for pilot scope.

Attachments included: redwood_po_mapping_example.csv (CSV stub with 3 example lines).

Let me know if you want the CSV schema as a Google Sheet — I can share it with editing rights.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Procurement Ops, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

Irene/Dev —

Thanks for the clear guidance and the sample CSV. We attached an updated supplier form with the remit email and ACH details filled, plus the signed W-9. We set the preferred item_code to be alphanumeric (e.g., CC-GPU-P100-001) to align with our SKU scheme.

One ask: the pilot needs a soft PO by 2027-09-06. Can Redwood commit to the expedited 48–72 hour path if we mark the form as "expedite"? We'll also add a short note in the supplier form explaining the business justification and attach a technical point-of-contact (Maya Singh).

If you can confirm the expedite path and that PO prefix is accepted (RDW- optional), we'll finalize on our side today.

Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Procurement
Catalyst Cloud
